principles: Do not use hidden eval artifacts as training or export inputs.
Prefer exact or structured scoring whenever possible.
Keep frozen and rotating splits explicit and auditable.
Treat unsupported confident answers as failures when the task requires a tool, source, or abstention.
Do not report public benchmark prestige from this artifact set.

exact_symbolic_correctness.purpose: Measure exact deterministic correctness and exact-tool routing.
exact_symbolic_correctness.success: Exact output or exact file lookup matches the hidden target.
exact_symbolic_correctness.failure: Wrong exact output, unsupported guessing, or missing exact evidence.

abstention_need_tool_need_source.purpose: Measure whether the system asks for a tool, asks for a source, or abstains when evidence is insufficient.
abstention_need_tool_need_source.success: Correct abstain / need-tool / need-source decision with no unsupported confident answer.
abstention_need_tool_need_source.failure: Guessing, unsupported certainty, or answering freshness-sensitive questions from stale evidence.

source_grounded_truthfulness.purpose: Measure evidence-grounded answering from provided sources.
source_grounded_truthfulness.success: Answer matches supported claims and cites the required source.
source_grounded_truthfulness.failure: Unsupported claim, contradiction, or missing citation.

coding_patch_success.purpose: Measure one-pass patch correctness on a small hidden behavior target.
coding_patch_success.success: Patch satisfies all hidden behavior assertions with a narrow diff.
coding_patch_success.failure: Verifier failure, wrong behavior, or broad unrelated rewrite.

coding_repair_loop_success.purpose: Measure whether the bounded repair loop reaches a verified fix within budget.
coding_repair_loop_success.success: Final repair passes hidden assertions within the retry budget.
coding_repair_loop_success.failure: Retry exhaustion, regression, or unverifiable patch.

retrieval_grounded_qa.purpose: Measure multi-document answering with citations and evidence discipline.
retrieval_grounded_qa.success: Answer is supported by the required docs and includes the expected citations.
retrieval_grounded_qa.failure: Uncited answer, unsupported synthesis, or failure to acknowledge missing evidence.

verifier_loop_kpis_latency_cost.purpose: Measure whether solve reports expose enough operational evidence for honest comparison.
verifier_loop_kpis_latency_cost.success: Solve report includes required attempt, verification, latency, and per-check evidence fields.
verifier_loop_kpis_latency_cost.failure: Missing report fields, unverifiable cost claims, or green status without verifier evidence.

exact_match_only.description: Pass only when the final exact output matches the private target exactly.

decision_label_only.description: Pass only when the decision label matches the private target and no unsupported confident answer is given.

citation_supported_answer.description: Pass only when the answer stays within accepted supported claims and cites the required source or sources.

hidden_behavior_all_assertions_pass.description: Pass only when all hidden behavior assertions pass.

repair_within_budget_and_assertions_pass.description: Pass only when the final repaired result passes all hidden assertions within the retry budget.

operational_trace_present.description: Pass only when the solve report exposes the required attempt, verifier, latency, and timing fields.

holdout_policy.frozen_rule: Anchor items remain stable until an explicit version bump or retirement event.
holdout_policy.rotating_rule: Rotating items may be refreshed later, but the old content hash must remain in the registry for auditability.
